lines.beaver: 경찰서 앞입니다. 사건 경위를 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: We're outside the police station. Could you explain what happened?
lines.beaver_roman: gyeongchalseo abimnida. sageon gyeongwireul malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 어젯밤 군부대 철조망 쪽에서 침입 경보가 울렸습니다.
lines.en: Last night, an intrusion alarm went off near a military base fence.
lines.roman: eojetbam gunbudae cheoljomang jjogeseo chimip gyeongboga ullyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: When did the police arrive at the scene?
lines.en: We were dispatched right after the alarm and arrived in 10 minutes.
lines.roman: gyeongbo jikhu chuldonghae sipbun mane dochakaetseumnida.

lines.learner: 철조망을 넘던 남성 한 명을 현장에서 검거했습니다.
lines.en: We caught a man climbing over the fence at the scene.
lines.roman: cheoljomangeul neomdeon namseong han myeongeul hyeonjangeseo geomgeohaetseumnida.

lines.beaver: 그 남성이 군사 구역을 침범한 이유는요?
lines.beaver_en: Why did the man trespass into the military zone?
lines.beaver_roman: geu namseongi gunsa guyeogeul chimbeomhan iyuneunyo?
lines.en: He stated that he came in to take photos.

lines.beaver_en: Some people suspect he may be a spy.
lines.learner: 간첩 가능성도 열어 두고 수사하고 있습니다.
lines.en: We're investigating without ruling out that he's a spy.
lines.roman: gancheop ganeungseongdo yeoreo dugo susahago itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Has anyone behind it been identified?
lines.learner: 아직입니다. 배후 세력이 있는지 조사 중입니다.
lines.en: Not yet. We're checking if there's a group behind it.
lines.roman: ajigimnida. baehu seryeogi inneunji josa jungimnida.

lines.learner: 범행에 가담한 사람이 한 명 더 있는 것 같습니다.
lines.en: It seems one more person took part in the crime.
lines.roman: beomhaenge gadamhan sarami han myeong deo inneun geot gatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Hasn't that person been caught yet?
lines.learner: 네, 현재 수배 중이며 검거에 주력하고 있습니다.
lines.en: Right, he's wanted, and we're focused on catching him.
lines.roman: ne, hyeonjae subae jungimyeo geomgeoe juryeokago itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Who commanded the response at the scene?
lines.en: I commanded it myself and also worked with the military.

lines.beaver: 마지막으로 시민들께 한 말씀 해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Lastly, would you say a word to the public?
lines.beaver_roman: majimageuro simindeulkke han malsseum hae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 수상한 사람은 바로 신고해 주십시오. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Please report anyone suspicious right away. Thank you.
lines.roman: susanghan sarameun baro singohae jusipsio. gamsahamnida.
